ITRDCSA 22/23 5.1 Digital Technologies and Communications Services

grants.n: The Grantee will provide new and upgraded mobile voice and data services in specified regional, rural and remote locations, using a combination of brownfield and greenfield sites and upgrades to existing fibre networks and backhaul.

The Grantee will upgrade the NBN service technologies in the towns of Cunnamulla, Quilpie, Mullewa, Ravensthorpe, Boulia, Julia Creek, Sea Lake, Fitzroy Crossing, Onslow, Lameroo and Pinnaroo to improve connectivity and support local communities.

The Grantee will install the Western Desert Aboriginal Lands Communication Network, a broadband communications system, to service the remote Aboriginal communities of Kunawarritji, Punmu, Parnngurr and Jigalong.

This Grantee will upgrade WiFi and Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Telephone services for the Tjuntjunjara Aboriginal Community, the Aboriginal community of the Kalumburu Outstations and the Aboriginal community of Mowanjum.
The Grantee will deploy a fixed wireless broadband network to connect the existing CRISP wireless network to the Central, Eastern and Southern parts of the Central Wheatbelt region.
The project will upgrade sites and deploy new fixed wireless sites to improve broadband services in the Harvey region and Busselton region of Western Australia.
The Grantee will deploy a fixed wireless network in the Livingstone Agricultural Precinct, Queensland, and in the Cradle Coast Agricultural Precinct, Tasmania.

The Grantee will deploy a high-speed fixed wireless broadband network, backhaul, public Wi-Fi & free network to improve connectivity between Richmond, Croydon and the surrounding area, Normanton to Georgetown and the Gilbert River Agricultural Precinct
The Grantee will deliver a fibre broadband network to the suburb of White Gums, Alice Springs, providing improved connectivity to the area.

The Grantee will upgrade the fixed wireless network in the Bullio area of the Southern Highlands, New South Wales, and upgrade the fixed wireless network along Tugalong Road in the Canyonleigh area of the Southern Highlands, New South Wales.

The Grantee will deploy a fixed wireless network and corresponding fibre backhaul in the Mackay area, including Finch Hatton, Pinnacle, Gargett, Eungella and the surrounding areas of Marian and Mirani.

The Grantee will construct a fixed wireless network to deliver broadband services and public Wi-Fi to remote Aboriginal communities located in the Shire of Halls Creek in the East Kimberley region of Western Australia.
The Grantee will deploy a fixed wireless network across the Mareeba Local Government area.

The Grantee will build a 4G ecoSphere network, as well as an mmWave Fixed Wireless Access network in the Wimmera Southern Mallee (WSM) region of Western Victoria and to a number of regional towns north-west of Dubbo.

The Grantee will deploy nine new satellite femto cells in Western Australia to provide improved mobile coverage at nine popular and remote surf beaches along the West Australian coast identified as a risk of shark attacks.
